description: This PHP script handles database backup and migration operations for vtiger CRM, including authentication, configuration loading, and executing backup or database copy actions based on request parameters.

classes.name: DatabaseConfig
classes.description: Configuration object for database connection parameters.

classes.name: MysqlSource

classes.name: Database
